title: Preserve selection on empty IME commit
platforms: Windows GNU build and Wine unit tests
changes: Treat an empty IME commit as clearing pending composition without replacing the selected draft.
validation: Windows GNU runtime and test builds passed; four editor, ten command and one panel Wine tests passed, including selection preservation.
limitations: Wine sends a real IME result after the composition-end event in the observed Cangjie case; Winit discards that later result. Real console composition and native Windows remain unverified under DBG2-14.
